'''Marric''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Marric was a war hero of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and high-ranking member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] who, in truth, worked for the Sith Empire undercover and revealed finally his allegiance during the [[Battle for Sobrik|liberation]] of [[Sobrik]]<ref name="Liberating Sobrik">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Liberating Sobrik|Balmorra}}</ref> by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual. Marric was defeated by the individual, and taken into custody.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Marric appears in the mission "Liberating Sobrik" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
